parent_objective: audit the partial source-coverage repair result before any routing smoke
supersedes: direct routing smoke after partial source repair

public_gates: M2027 must audit and synthesize M2026 artifacts without rerun
M2027 must state whether T2/T3 require new source generation or threshold/source-kind semantics audit
M2027 must not admit routing smoke unless readiness is supported by M2026 artifacts
M2027 must choose continue pivot stop or promote-to-next-branch because the local-search cadence fired
M2027 must keep ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits partial source repair and synthesizes the source-coverage repair branch after local-search cadence
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process synthesis only; no driver performance mechanism ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if the audit would admit execution despite panel_ready_for_routing_smoke=false
stop if the audit weakens source-diversity thresholds without a semantics argument
stop if the audit routes to another repair loop without new source evidence
fallback_plan: route to T2/T3 same-family source-generation design if current artifacts are insufficient
route to threshold/source-kind semantics audit if the current threshold is mismatched to family semantics
route to branch synthesis if repair loops have become local search
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2026 partial repair leaves T2/T3 unready and the branch exceeds the non-evidence cadence

training_stage.stage_objective: controlled comparison source-coverage repair result audit and branch synthesis
admission_evidence: M2026 writes clean partial source repair artifacts with guardrail_violation_count 0
blocked_shortcuts: do not run execution from partial panel readiness
do not claim finite-window-vs-GRU or paper-level evidence
allowed_updates: M2027 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2027 classifies T2/T3 unresolved source-kind-share blockers
M2027 selects a single next route

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2027 audits source coverage only and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2027.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If T2/T3 remain unresolved, route to source generation, threshold semantics audit, or synthesis rather than execution.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns M2022-M2026 controlled-panel source coverage work into a next-branch decision
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can determine whether the paper-route controlled comparison needs new T2/T3 source generation before execution
must_synthesize_if: always; this is the required synthesis milestone after the local-search cadence fired

hypothesis: The partial M2026 repair can be audited into a single next route without running execution or weakening source thresholds.
success_criteria: M2027 identifies whether T2/T3 need new source generation threshold/source-kind semantics audit split routing or stop
M2027 answers the required synthesis questions
guardrail and claim boundaries remain intact
no rerun ranking finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: audit admits routing smoke despite panel_ready_for_routing_smoke=false
audit weakens thresholds without a source-kind semantics argument
audit starts another local repair loop without new source evidence
synthesis questions are missing or the next branch decision is ambiguous
environment rollout or policy action execution occurs
ranking or finite-window-vs-GRU claims are made

commands.name: synthesis
commands.command: write docs/m2027-paper-route-controlled-comparison-source-coverage-repair-result-audit.md as a result audit and branch synthesis

decision_rule: M2027 passes if it audits M2026 cleanly and chooses a single non-execution next route for unresolved T2/T3 coverage.
